message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills, modern scares, and some hidden gems you might enjoy for a Friday night movie marathon:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological horror masterpiece with an iconic performance by Jack Nicholson. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn dread that culminates in a truly unsettling finale. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | A smart social thriller that blends horror with sharp satire. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that turns the genre on its head—beautiful yet deeply disturbing. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 6 | **The Babadook** (2014) | A psychological horror that’s as much about grief as it is about monsters. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Suspenseful, tense, and a great way to keep everyone on the edge of their seats. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted supernatural thriller that’s both scary and entertaining. |
| 9 | **The Witch** (2015) | A slow‑burn period horror that builds dread through atmosphere and subtlety. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (2012) | A meta‑take on horror tropes that’s clever, funny, and genuinely scary. |

Feel free to pick a few from different sub‑genres (psychological, supernatural, slasher, etc.) to keep the night varied. Enjoy your fright-filled Friday!
